title: PREDICTIVE BRCA GENETIC TESTING IN ITALIAN PATIENTS WITH BREAST CANCER: A POSITION PAPER OF ITALIAN SCIENTIFIC SOCIETIES [Italian Association of Medical Oncology(AIOM); Italian Association of Radiotherapy and Clinical Oncology (AIRO); Italian National Association of Breast Surgeons (ANISC); Italian Society of Pathological Anatomy and Diagnostic Cytology (SIAPeC-IAP); Italian Society of Surgical Oncology (SICO); Italian Society of Human Genetic (SIGU); Italian Society of General Practice (SIMG); Italian Society of Medical and Interventional Radiology (SIRM)].
authors: Cortesi, L; Miglietta, F; Arecco, L; Bernardi, D; Biganzoli, L; Del Mastro, L; Dieci, M V; Foglietta, J; Fortunato, L; Franco, P; Cordisco, E Lucci; Mantellini, P; Marchio', C; Meduri, B; Micallo, G; Musolino, A; Salvetti, A; Turchetti, D; Zambelli, A; Angiolini, C; Cinieri, S; Conte, P F; Curigliano, G; Dessena, M; Fabi, A; Leonardi, M C; Meattini, I; Montemezzi, S; Puglisi, F; Sapino, A; Taffurelli, M; Cinquini, M; Gori, S
one_liner_zh: 该文是意大利多学会关于乳腺癌患者BRCA基因检测的立场文件，聚焦临床遗传咨询与治疗决策，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The introduction of Poly (ADP-ribose) Polymerase (PARP) inhibitors in both metastatic and early-stage breast cancer (BC) treatment has led to the emergence of Mainstreaming Cancer Genetics (MCG) as a new approach to genetic counselling, predictive of therapy outcomes. Therefore, the BRCA testing criteria for therapeutic purposes require further implementation. This position paper outlines the Italian indications for predictive genetic testing, approved by a multidisciplinary Expert Panel representing major scientific societies involved in BC treatment in Italy. We utilized the Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluation (GRADE) approach, and framed clinical questions as population, intervention, comparison and outcome (PICO). The final recommendations were determined through a voting process, covering key topics such as eligibility criteria for onco-genetic counselling, the role of contralateral prophylactic mastectomy (CPM) in patients harboring BRCA1/2 germline pathogenic variants (gPV), and the positioning of predictive BRCA1/2 test. As results, the Expert Panel defined three distinct patient groups eligible for onco-genetic counselling, based on the a priori likelihood of carrying a gPV and the purpose of testing (predictive vs preventive). A conditional recommendation in favor of CPM in patients with a history of surgically treated BC and a BRCA gPV was suggested. Finally, a multidisciplinary pathway for BRCA testing was proposed, for patients with triple negative and hormone receptor-positive (HR+)/HER2-negative (HER2-) BC. In conclusion, the predictive BRCA testing inside the onco-genetic framework marks an important step-forward in BC management. However, the integration of somatic testing, digital pathology, and artificial intelligence-driven models could refine patient selection for tailored treatments.
abstract_zh: 聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）抑制剂在转移性和早期乳腺癌（BC）治疗中的引入，催生了主流化癌症遗传学（MCG）作为一种新的遗传咨询方法，用于预测治疗结局。因此，用于治疗目的的BRCA检测标准需要进一步实施。本立场文件概述了意大利对预测性遗传检测的适应症，该适应症由参与意大利乳腺癌治疗的主要科学学会代表组成的多学科专家小组批准。我们采用了推荐分级评估、制定与评价（GRADE）方法，并将临床问题构建为人群、干预、对照和结局（PICO）框架。最终建议通过投票过程确定，涵盖关键主题，如肿瘤遗传咨询的资格标准、携带BRCA1/2胚系致病性变异（gPV）患者中对侧预防性乳房切除术（CPM）的作用，以及预测性BRCA1/2检测的定位。作为结果，专家小组根据携带gPV的先验可能性和检测目的（预测性 vs 预防性），定义了三个不同的患者群体，符合肿瘤遗传咨询资格。对既往接受过手术治疗的乳腺癌且携带BRCA gPV的患者，提出了有条件推荐支持CPM。最后，为三阴性及激素受体阳性（HR+）/HER2阴性（HER2-）乳腺癌患者，提出了BRCA检测的多学科路径。总之，肿瘤遗传框架内的预测性BRCA检测标志着乳腺癌管理的重要进步。然而，体细胞检测、数字病理学和人工智能驱动模型的整合，可能进一步优化患者选择，以实现个体化治疗。
